top_deficiency_types.title: Develop and maintain an Emergency Preparedness Program (EP).
Install a fire alarm system that can be heard throughout the facility.
Keep aisles, corridors, and exits free of obstruction in case of emergency.
Install corridor and hallway doors that block smoke.
Keep all essential equipment working safely.
Ensure each resident receives and the facility provides food that accommodates resident allergies, intolerances, and preferences, as well as appealing options.
Give residents notice of Medicaid/Medicare coverage and potential liability for services not covered.
Ensure that a nursing home area is free from accident hazards and provides adequate supervision to prevent accidents.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Ensure a licensed pharmacist perform a monthly drug regimen review, including the medical chart, following irregularity reporting guidelines in developed policies and procedures.
Ensure that residents are free from significant medication errors.
